questions.q: Which Java release introduced lambdas and the Stream API?
o: Java 8
Java 7
Java 11
Java 17
questions.w: Java 8 (2014) added lambdas, streams, `Optional`, default methods and the new date-time API.

questions.q: Which feature arrived in Java 9 and reshaped how large applications are packaged?
o: The module system (JPMS)
Records
Virtual threads
Text blocks
questions.w: Java 9 added modules with `module-info.java`. Many projects still run on the classpath.

questions.q: What does `var` do in `var list = new ArrayList<String>();` (Java 10)?
o: The compiler infers the type; the variable stays statically typed
The variable becomes dynamically typed at run time
The variable can hold any other type later on
The variable is made automatically final
questions.w: `var` is only for local variables with an initialiser. It is not a keyword for fields or method parameters.

questions.q: Which of these is a long-term support (LTS) release?
o: Java 17
Java 16
Java 18
Java 20
questions.w: LTS releases are 8, 11, 17, 21 and 25. Between them are six-month feature releases. Spring Boot 3 requires Java 17 or later.

A class that logs every method call it receives
A database row that only Hibernate can map
A thread-safe list implementation for queues
questions.w: Records suit DTOs and value objects. Their fields are final and they cannot extend another class.

questions.q: What problem do virtual threads (Java 21) mainly address?
o: Handling very many blocking tasks without one OS thread each
Speeding up CPU-heavy number crunching on all cores
Replacing the garbage collector with a new one
Encrypting network traffic between services
questions.w: Virtual threads are scheduled by the JVM on a few carrier threads. Blocking I/O parks them cheaply. CPU-bound work gains nothing.

questions.q: What do sealed classes (Java 17) let you do?
o: Restrict which classes may extend or implement a type
Prevent any class from ever being instantiated
Encrypt the class files on disk
Make every field of the class private
questions.w: `sealed ... permits A, B` gives a closed hierarchy. Together with pattern matching in `switch`, the compiler can check exhaustiveness.

questions.q: Which Java 15+ feature makes multi-line strings, such as embedded JSON or SQL, easier to write?
o: Text blocks written with triple quotes
String templates written with backticks
The `var` keyword for local variables
Switch expressions with arrows
questions.w: Text blocks (`""" ... """`) remove most escaping and keep indentation sensible.
